preconditions.expression: V >= 1 and all(0 <= u < V for neighbors in adj for u in neighbors)
preconditions.description: V is a positive integer, and all vertices in adjacency lists are valid indices (0 to V-1).
Adjacency list is well-formed (may contain loops or duplicate edges).

preconditions.expression: all(u in neighbors or v in neighbors for u in range(V) for v in range(V) if u != v and (u in adj[v] or v in adj[u]))
preconditions.description: The graph is undirected and connected (ignoring loops).

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= v < V for v in return_value) or return_value == [-1]
postconditions.description: All returned vertices are valid indices (0 to V-1), or [-1] if no articulation points exist.
Returned vertices are unique and sorted in ascending order.

postconditions.expression: return_value == [-1] or all(any(0 <= u < V and u != v and u not in adj[v] for u in range(V)) for v in return_value)
postconditions.description: If return_value is not [-1], each vertex v in it is an articulation point: removing v disconnects the graph into ≥2 components.

postconditions.expression: return_value == [-1] or all(not any(0 <= u < V and u != v and u not in adj[v] for u in range(V)) for v in range(V) if v not in return_value)
postconditions.description: If return_value is not [-1], no vertex outside it is an articulation point.
